answer: Every reward paid on the dawn market stays inside a 12 epoch clawback hold where each worker posts a refundable stake bond and answers a 64 KB spot audit every 6 hours. If a farm launches 100 fake accounts across a grove cluster from one master seed, any key link found during those 12 epochs burns 100% of their 30,000 credit bond and 8,000 credit pending payout, a net loss. One solo member on the tundra outpost posts 300 credits once and withdraws in full after 12 epochs. This fails if operators generate truly separate keys.
